title: Certificate chain validation missing CRL/OCSP revocation checks
description: cert.rs validate_chain() checks validity periods and signature chains but performs no revocation checking (no CRL, no OCSP). The module doc says 'No network calls are made' and the workspace CLAUDE.md says 'No OCSP, no CRL fetch. Keeping it fresh is the caller's responsibility.' However, the limitation is documented only in CLAUDE.md (a dev-facing file), not in the public rustdoc for verify(). A user reading only the published crate docs will assume normal X.509 chain validation, which conventionally includes revocation. A compromised-key scenario where the cert is revoked will verify as Ok(verified=true). This will generate CVE-class issues.
close_reason: design decision per CLAUDE.md: no network calls, no CRL/OCSP; caller responsibility
